transcript: So if you go in here where it says attribution, you have these different attribution models right here. And some of this is self-explanatory, but essentially, if I go to first click right now, what it's going to show me is what are my results from people who click from the ad and buy there and then. In other words, what channel is driving you the best conversion traffic? Then if I go to last click, that is going to show people who saw an ad, let's say it on Facebook. But then three days later, they saw an ad on Google display and they converted as a result of the Google display. And so they would be a last click conversion. And then you also have linear paid and linear all and triple attribution. These are basically triple whales version of trying to calculate what the rest is by using their own model. And it involves AI, I believe, and a bunch of other stuff. But it just gives you a pretty good overview of what is actually driving your revenue.
